eventDescription:
On the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, Vidhaigal Organization, Golden Hearts Lions Club, Alliance Club, and the residents of Chinnasamy Nagar jointly organized a tree plantation drive at Chinnasamy Nagar Park.
It was heartwarming to see the enthusiastic participation of local residents in planting trees. Their sense of responsibility and ownership was truly inspiring when they proudly expressed, "We will take responsibility for continuously maintaining and caring for these trees."
